title: Owner availability narrowcast and ask prioritizer
body:
Purpose: lightweight one-off tracker to rapid-map who can pick up short (<=8h) cross-functional asks over the next 5 business days. Designed for narrowcast pings to improve triage speed during surge windows.

How to use: update row for your team; fill Availability (hrs), Best window (date/time), Slack pinged? (y/n + handle), Rapid fallback (name + team), and Quick blockers. The sheet auto-suggests a priority bucket using a simple urgency score (Impact*1.5 + SLA weight + Availability penalty). Use the Priority column to decide 1-3 escalation (1=do now/hand-off, 2=plan this week, 3=defer).

Columns: Owner | Team | Current availability (hrs) | Best window (local) | Last ping (timestamp) | Slack handle | Primary fast-fallback | Ask short description | Est. hours | Urgency inputs (Impact:0-5) | SLA weight (0-3) | Computed urgency score | Priority bucket | Quick blockers | Notes / next step | Last updated by

Sample rows (populate with real names):
1) Priya Nair | product-ops | 4 | 2026-06-17 10:00-12:00 PDT | 2026-06-16 09:12 | @priya | Marisol Gomez (solutions-eng) | Confirm canary rollback window for route /v1/chat | 2 | Impact 4 | SLA 2 | 4*1.5 + 2 - (4/8)=6 +2 -0.5 = 7.5 -> 7.5 | 1 | none | Pinged Marisol to pair on rollback plan; can take 2h | Priya Nair

2) Ethan Park | eng-serving-runtime | 6 | 2026-06-17 14:00-17:00 PDT | 2026-06-16 10:05 | @ethan | Owen Liu (sre) | Investigate 95th pct latency spike on dedicated pool us-west-2 | 5 | Impact 5 | SLA 3 | 5*1.5 +3 - (6/8)=7.5+3-0.75=9.75 -> 9.75 | 1 | needs logs access token | Created quicktrace ticket; asked SRE to grab traces; ETA 4h | Ethan Park

3) Marisol Gomez | solutions-engineering | 2 | 2026-06-18 09:00-11:00 PDT | 2026-06-15 16:00 | @marisol | Support rotation (Anita) | Quick customer demo prep for on-prem install checklist | 3 | Impact 3 | SLA 1 | 3*1.5 +1 - (2/8)=4.5+1-0.25=5.25 -> 5.25 | 2 | waiting on infra checklist | Will draft checklist and hand to SE playbook; needs 2h | Marisol Gomez

4) Owen Liu | site-reliability-engineering | 1 | 2026-06-19 08:00-09:00 PDT | 2026-06-16 07:45 | @owen | Ethan Park (serving-runtime) | Short-run config revert for autoscaler policy test | 1 | Impact 2 | SLA 2 | 2*1.5 +2 - (1/8)=3+2-0.125=4.875 -> 4.9 | 2 | requires deploy window | Can do 1h; needs release lead present | Owen Liu

5) Anita Rodriguez | customer-success | 3 | 2026-06-17 11:00-14:00 PDT | 2026-06-16 13:22 | @anita | Marisol Gomez (solutions-eng) | Patch customer billing mismatch for reserved capacity trial | 4 | Impact 4 | SLA 2 | 4*1.5 +2 - (3/8)=6+2-0.375=7.625 ->7.6 | 1 | requires finance permission | Raised billing ticket to finance; needs confirmation by EOD | Anita Rodriguez

6) Zoe Chen | observability | 0.5 | 2026-06-18 15:00-15:30 PDT | 2026-06-16 09:01 | @zoe | Ethan Park (serving-runtime) | Quick dashboard tweak: expose per-model route latency drop-down | 1 | Impact 2 | SLA 1 | 2*1.5 +1 - (0.5/8)=3+1-0.0625=3.9375 ->3.9 | 2 | low priority | Can do 30m but needs design spec | Zoe Chen

Notes and heuristics:
- Availability penalty = availability_hours / 8 (caps at 1). Lower availability increases computed urgency.
- Impact ranges: 5 = customer production outage; 4 = degraded critical feature; 3 = affects multiple teams; 2 = single-team annoyance; 1 = informational.
- SLA weight: 3 = 1-hour SLO, 2 = same-day, 1 = 3-day, 0 = no SLO.
- Priority bucket mapping: urgency >= 8 -> 1 (do now or hand-off), 5-7.9 -> 2 (plan this week), <5 -> 3 (defer or schedule).

Quick metrics snapshot (as of last_modified):
- Total owners listed: 12 (this sheet uses a single page summary)
- Immediate capacity (sum availability >=2h): 28 hours across teams
- High-urgency asks (priority 1): 3 active

Open actions / next steps:
- Priya: push this sheet to #ops-narrowcast and call out Priority 1 rows with one-line ask (do by EOD).
- Ethan: follow up with SRE on traces ticket link (linear ISSUE-3212).
- Marisol: finalize on-prem demo checklist and share playbook link; tag Anita.
- Anita/Finance: confirm billing adj (IA-987) by EOD.

Audit trail: keep one-line last-updated entries (name + timestamp) so owner rotation is visible. When a row moves from Priority 2 -> 1, add brief reason in Notes.

Why this is different: compact, availability-centered, built for narrowcast pings (short-window asks), and includes an ad-hoc urgency formula to help non-engineering PMs pick whom to ping instead of broad channel noise.

Scratch area (for quick calcs):
- urgency_sample = impact*1.5 + sla - (avail_hours/8)
- example: impact 5, sla 3, avail 6 -> 7.5 +3 -0.75 = 9.75 -> priority 1

Slack snippet template for narrowcast (copy into #ops-narrowcast):
"Short ask: [one-line description]. ETA: [hh]. Priya Nair (product-ops) marked priority 1. Recommended: @<owner> or fallback @<fallback>. Please respond with ETA or DECLINE."

Last updated summary: 2026-06-21 by Priya Nair — moved two rows to Priority 1 after recent spike in latency on dedicated pool; pinged Ethan and Owen.
